name: S8050
source: JCET (江蘇長電) S8050 データシート (版 D、2014-10)
description: NPN 汎用トランジスタ 25V 500mA (SOT-23, ピン1=B 2=E 3=C)。データシート (JCET) の代表特性から作った等価モデル (同じ型番でもメーカーで特性が違います)
hfe_note: 表の hFE は min・max だけ (50 mA で 120〜400、ランクで分かれる) なので、hFE−IC の図 (VCE = 1 V、25 °C) の値をそのまま使いました。実物はランクと個体で大きく違います。
vaf: 出力特性 (Static Characteristic) の IB = 100・200 µA の線の傾きから (2〜16 V で 105・110 V)
remarks: S8050 has no single maker; this is JCET's (Jiangsu Changjiang), a common source, from LCSC's copy of the maker's PDF

read with `cargo run -p datasheet --example ds -- trace` on page 2 (hFE and fT with `keepthin`: the curves are thin and flat for long stretches and the minor grid is dotted; the solid decade lines that then come back were set aside). Each graph has two curves, 25 C and 100 C
hfe_norm: the hFE-IC figure (VCE = 1 V), the lower curve (25 C), 2 to 300 mA
vce_sat (mV in the figure), vbe_sat: beta = 10; 25 C is the lower VCE(sat) curve and the upper VBE(sat) one. vbe_on: the IC-VBE figure (VCE = 1 V), the right curve (25 C), read with `rows`
ft_typ: the fT-IC figure at 20 mA (VCE = 6 V; the table's condition), 280 MHz (the table gives min 150 MHz)
vaf: the static characteristic, IB = 100 uA: 21.3 mA at 2 V to 24.1 mA at 16 V; 200 uA: 42.9 to 45.2 mA from 2 to 8 V
